name: James P. Byrd
title: Cal Turner Chancellor's Chair of Wesleyan Studies
otherRoles: Associate Dean & Chair of Graduate Department of Religion
workingOn: Holds one of Vanderbilt's two Cal Turner Chancellor's Chairs in Wesleyan Studies and is UMC-ordained himself. He teaches History of the United Methodist Tradition and co-leads the new Turner-Barnett Program for Pastoral Formation alongside Bishop William McAlilly (retired, Tennessee-Western Kentucky Conference). His own scholarship is on the Bible in American religious and political history, not Methodism specifically — the UM teaching is a role he holds, not the center of his research.
